notes.title: Harvest Hills is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

Even though it's a cold January outside, I can feel the warm breeze and smell the freshly cut hay. How is that possible? Well, it's because I just played the recently released Harvest Hills farm simulator.

That's right – [b]Harvest Hills is OUT NOW![/b]

Don't miss out – grab your copy and immerse yourself in a beautiful world where you run your very own ranch. In the game, you'll cultivate various crops, take care of animals, and produce homemade products. As you complete simple tasks, you'll unlock new farm objects that help you expand your farm's production. Sell your goods at the local market to earn money and use it to upgrade or automate your farm.

I hope you all have a wonderful time playing Harvest Hills! ✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2259620/Harvest_Hills

notes.title: Major demo update is out!
notes.notes:
In this update for the demo, I have made some exciting changes to enhance your gaming experience:

[b]Relaxing Gameplay:[/b] Say goodbye to time limits! Enjoy a new free-run mode where you can look after of your farm at your own pace, without any pressure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/b549ed2570305188e3d847a2fb5fffab6c38737f.png[/img]

[b]Market Truck Feature:[/b] Introducing the market truck! Earn money by selling your farm products at the local market. Keep an eye out for the truck's visits, where you can sell your goods at competitive prices. Use the earnings to invest in new farm objects and boost your productivity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/ecb7a10e8e27c40b958806a9f2b70bc105708265.png[/img]

[b]New Level System:[/b] Unlocking new farm objects is now tied to challenges. Meet specific product selling targets to progress and gain access to new farm objects and upgrades for your rancho.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/f8726ab1239497a31fd75e862300a8f32fd21431.png[/img]

Sounds interesting? Download the demo now and start managing your own farm!

notes.title: Demo is released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/db296f84cad2244f0e35d8dfafad8539f31fffec.png[/img]
I'm thrilled to share the news of the [b]Harvest Hills demo release![/b] Dive into the shoes of a dedicated farmer as you manage your own ranch!

You will face 12 unique levels that require you to harvest and produce a specific list of products before time runs out. Start with a single garden bed housing a few vegetable kinds. And finish with a large farm having a big variety of vegetables, fruit trees, animals, and even a home-made product machine. Each level comes with a time limit, making it a good way to put your strategic farming skills to the test.

Play the demo and share your thoughts! Your feedback is invaluable and will contribute to enhancing the game even further.

Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FsxDKxYPMG]Discord server[/url] to discuss your experiences and become part of the ongoing development conversation.

Happy gaming!
